decisions.backward_rule: The post-hoc v2 result on the 2012-2015 backward holdout is sufficient as descriptive evidence.
decisions.insufficient_support_policy: If the new data fall below the forward support floor (120 paired days and 25 eligible weeks), Plan B remains, without completing the sample with previously examined dates.
